release_items.text: Engine update: the game client the run plays in is brought up to date. In co-op, buffs from your friends now show this game's numbers.
Under-the-hood engine improvements from the client the game is built on.

In co-op, buffs from your friends show Azeroth Survivors' numbers instead of the original game's: a warrior's Battle Shout, a druid's Rejuvenation or Dire Bear Form, and the rest, on you and on the party frames.
Boss attack markers on the ground now always show on top of spell effects: a Frost Trap, a Consecration, a Hurricane no longer hides where the next attack lands.
The Discord button and the site's Discord link now open our new invite, discord.gg/azerothsurvivors.
Co-op achievements: 14 new feats for parties, earned by everyone in the party. They bring hats, cloaks, a tabard, four companions, a co-op luck perk and a White Devilsaur for hunters.

New Co-op achievements tab, 14 achievements done with friends: Better Together, Five of a Kind, Rest in Photosynthesis, Against All Odds, The Brotherhood Falls, Things That Go Bump in the Night, For the Team, Jurassic Pack, Hakkar Smoothie, Holy Frame Drops, Dragonslayers, Totem'ly Balanced, The Old Gods Have No Friends and Together, To the End. Every player in the party earns them, whoever lands the killing blow.
Zones beaten in co-op are remembered across runs, for the achievements that ask for several (For the Team, Dragonslayers, Together, To the End).

New looks from them: the Admiral's Hat, Bloodsail Admiral's Hat, Embrace of the Lycan and Whitemane's Chapeau for your head; the Cape of the Brotherhood, Cloak of the Brood Lord and Cloak of the Devoured for your back; and the Contest Winner's Tabard.
New companions: Ancient Protector, Mini Herod, Mini Nefarian and Mr. Bigglesworth.
United Front (from For the Team): +10% luck in every co-op run, for good.

White Devilsaur (from Jurassic Pack): a new switch at the bottom right of the hunter's Beast Mastery tree, free of points. On, one White Devilsaur fights for you in place of Tame Beast's wolf and Bestial Wrath's raptor, dealing what the two would.
The armory's look list scrolls when a slot has many looks, instead of running off the bottom of the pane.
notes: thanks **@DK Waiting Room** for achievements, if they suck d you can yell at him

description.text: Complete your first zone in co-op.
Complete any zone in co-op with all 5 players using the same class.
Defeat Kel'Thuzad in co-op with 5 Druids, all talented into Tranquility. Tranquility must deliver the killing blow.
Complete any zone in co-op with all four enemy difficulty modifiers at maximum.
Defeat Edwin VanCleef in co-op with 5 players, all using different classes.

description.text: Complete Duskwood in co-op without any player dying.
Complete Warsong Gulch and Arathi Basin in co-op.
Complete Un'Goro Crater in co-op with 5 Hunters.
Defeat Hakkar in co-op with 5 Warriors, all talented into Bladestorm. Whirlwind must deliver the killing blow.
Defeat High Inquisitor Whitemane in co-op with 5 Paladins, all having Consecration as their highest-ranked spell. Consecration must deliver the killing blow.
Defeat Azuregos and Nefarian in co-op.
Defeat Nefarian in co-op with 5 Shamans, all having Magma Totem as their highest-ranked spell. Magma Totem must deliver the killing blow.
